mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (measured by the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where the federal funds rate declines (3-month change < 0) are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the rank correlation is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5%, it signals a weak labor market and economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns, or the rank correlation between the trigger condition and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the 3-month change in CPI exceeds 0.5% (annualized), it signals a combination of low interest rates and rising inflation, increasing economic uncertainty and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL 3mo change > 0.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the rank correlation is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime defined by unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls over the past three months, the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened economic uncertainty and reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where the recession regime condition is met, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns, or the rank correlation between the regime condition and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (measured by the 3-month change) signals improving economic conditions and increased consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where housing starts rise (3-month change > 0) are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the rank correlation is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector and overall economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns, or the rank correlation between the trigger condition and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) show positive 3-month growth, it signals a robust consumer economy and rising demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in instances where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive 3-month growth are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the rank correlation is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high supply growth regime defined by industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% over the past three months, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to improved economic conditions and increased corporate profitability.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO 3mo change > 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns, or the rank correlation between the regime condition and returns is below 0.03.
